Gluten-Free Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
By: The Souper
Published: Thursday, September 30, 2010 - 3:53am

Ingredients




1 cup all-natural smooth or chunky peanut butter
1 cup sugar (½ cup brown sugar and ½ cup white gran1 whole egg
1 teaspoon baking soda

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. 2 Grease a baking sheet 3 Combine peanut butter and sugars and mix with electric mixer. 4 About 2 minutes) 5 Add one egg and baking soda to this mixture and continue to mix for about 2 more minutes. 6 Roll formed mixture into walnut-sized balls and put on the greased baking sheet. 7 With a fork, make criss-cross markings on the formed balls to flatten them a bit. 8 Option: add a few chocolate bits on top of the cookies before cooking. 9 Bake cookies for about 10 minutes until they are lightly browned. 10 Cool on the baking sheet for about two minutes.

About


Flourless Peanut Butter Cookie Recipe comes from The Gourmet Cookbook.

Comments:
The Souper

Easy baking project to do with children. Cookies are delicious even if not on restricted GF diet.
